spec_features.spec_quote: If the model emits explicit give-up language `give_up_patience` (default 3) times in a row with no action, end the rollout as `gave_up`
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:51-64: when a turn has no tool_calls, _looks_like_giveup(text) increments consecutive_giveups (reset to 0 otherwise); at line 62-64 `if consecutive_giveups >= give_up_patience: ended_reason='gave_up'; break` actually breaks the loop. _looks_like_giveup + _GIVEUP_MARKERS defined at lines 121-136. give_up_patience read from config (experiment.yaml give_up_patience:3) and passed through run_experiment.py:_do_rollout into run_rollout.
spec_features.notes: Fully enforced end-to-end; only fires on no-tool-call turns (consecutive run with no action), matching the claim.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Detect explicit give-up language to allow early stop, otherwise nudge it onward.
